title: Test exact own-export adoption when import confirms and applies beside a held task
outcome: Test exact own-export adoption when import confirms and applies beside a held task
acceptance: A deterministic Rust test drives one transaction that both confirms an exact own export and applies an incoming change beside one held task
Only an exact own commit with the recorded parent, exact changed paths and exact postimages is adopted; an extra path, changed bytes or wrong parent refuses with no durable effects
The held task retains its held admission and every later local edit remains owed to a subsequent export
The test runs after the 808a landing and adds no new gate or per-task Git process growth
